summary: West Fraser Timber Co. Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnished with the SEC on October 8, 2026, attaching a news release giving notice of its third-quarter 2026 results conference call. The call is scheduled for Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Pacific/11:00 a.m. Eastern, chaired by President and CEO Sean McLaren, with results released October 28, 2026. No special-situation transaction is involved; no stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. What to watch: routine quarterly earnings and operational commentary; no risk-arb angle.
